item.name: 04 Board CRUD
item.description: Skipped unless enableCrud is exactly true. Creates and removes its own Board, Post, and Comment; concurrent runs are not isolated from broad cleanup or shared-account side effects.

exec: if (pm.variables.get('enableCrud') === 'true' && (!pm.variables.get('email') || !pm.variables.get('password'))) throw new Error('Set non-empty email and password before running enabled 04 Board CRUD.');
const body = pm.response.json(); const token = body.data?.token;
pm.variables.set('token', pm.response.code === 200 && body.status === 'success' && typeof token === 'string' && token ? token : '');

if (pm.variables.get('enableCrud') === 'true' && !pm.variables.get('token')) { pm.test('CRUD session exists', () => pm.expect.fail('CRUD login did not produce a token; request was not sent.')); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }
const body = pm.response.json(); const id = body.data?.id;
pm.test('numeric ID returned', () => { pm.expect(id).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(Number.isInteger(id) && id > 0).to.eql(true); });
const valid = pm.response.code === 200 && body.status === 'success' && Number.isInteger(id) && id > 0 && body.data?.name === "Postman CRUD board";

if (pm.variables.get('enableCrud') === 'true' && !pm.variables.get('token')) { pm.test('CRUD session exists', () => pm.expect.fail('CRUD login did not produce a token; request was not sent.')); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }
if (pm.variables.get('enableCrud') === 'true' && !/^\d+$/.test(String(pm.variables.get('boardId') || ''))) throw new Error('Missing boardId; an earlier CRUD request failed.');
